守密人你好：
       弥萨格大学校务处将于8月25日20:45(UTC+8) 进行校内设施修复，更新完成后您将得到通知，重新进入游戏。对于更新可能给大家带来的不便，我们会准备一份补给物资以示歉意。祝大家调查顺利！ 
       更新内容中，末尾标注 ☆ 的事项来自社区各位守密人的问题反馈。感谢各位守密人的耐心与帮助！
  
【补给物资】
在线维护补偿：银芯×50
  
【领取条件】
领取时间截至2026年9月8日23:59。请记得及时前往邮箱领取补给物资哦。  
 
【更新内容】
一、故事
【本地化】
● 英语
    ○ 活动「在春天凋零以前」中的各事件的故事描述翻译优化，使表达措辞更加自然。
    ○ 部分「核心课题」奖励的头像、对战表情的描述优化，与过往描述格式统一。
● 韩语
    ○ 唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」的技能描述翻译优化。
    ○ 活动「新月与深雪」的玩法说明翻译优化。
 
二、问题修复
【故事】
● 通讯器
    ○ 修复了「卡拉布」的通讯对话中存在错别字的问题。 
● 本地化
    ○ 英语
        ■ 修复了头像「以银钥之名：卡拉布」的描述中，唤醒体名字翻译错误的问题。☆
        ■ 修复了解锁「密契结合」机制的提示信息错误显示为机器翻译的问题。☆
        ■ 修复了「调查行动」第一部第四章主线故事探索事件「深埋之物」描述中库姆的人称代词翻译错误的问题。☆
        ■ 修复了「调查行动」第一部第七章主线故事第11节「魔术」关卡描述中的一处拼写错误问题。☆
        ■ 修复了「调查行动」第二部第五章主线「命定剧场」中的敌人技能「凌驾命运的悲歌」描述翻译不准确的问题。
        ■ 修复了「调查行动」第二部第六章主线故事「山宴」中的一处拼写错误问题。☆
        ■ 修复了造物「异乡邮票夹」效果翻译措辞不准确的问题。☆
        ■ 修复了命轮「往昔的花与诗」与「35mm的魔法」的效果描述中「死亡抵抗」翻译措辞不统一的问题。☆
        ■ 修复了活动「在春天凋零以前」中部分活动玩法机制翻译措辞不统一的问题。☆
            ● 献诗：从「Offering」统一为「Verse」。
            ● 合成献诗：从「Synthesize Offering」统一为「Compose a Verse」。
            ● 缪斯的眷顾：从「Muzus Blessing/Muse's Blessing」统一为「The Muse's Favor」。
            ● 春天的献礼：从「Spring's Gift」统一为「The Gift of Spring」。
    ○ 韩语
        ■ 修复了「각성체」错误显示为「깨어남체」、「실」错误显示为「실타래」的问题。
        ■ 修复了「调查行动」剧情中一句台词会露出尖括号标记原文的问题。
        ■ 修复了部分文本内容不正确的问题。
    ○ 多种语言
        ■ 修复了德语、法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、土耳其语等部分语言设置下，「守密纪行-终北纪行」中的任务描述错误地显示为通关 6-8/6-4 的问题，正确条件为通关 6-9/6-5。
        ■ 修复了部分语言设置下，公告内容错误地显示为繁体中文的问题。
        ■ 修复了部分语言设置下，「唤醒体-密契」界面的套装效果描述可能显示不全的问题。
        ■ 修复了部分语言设置下，「唤醒」中部分角色活动唤醒的唤醒体/命轮说明可能显示不全的问题。
        ■ 修复了部分语言设置下，部分文本中的演出标记未被正确处理，导致尖括号原文显示出来的问题。
        ■ 修复了部分语言设置下，技能与状态说明中用于处理单复数变化的排版标记书写错误，导致露出标记原文或整段说明无法正常显示的问题。
        ■ 修复了部分语言设置下，部分称谓没有正常显示的问题。
        ■ 修复了所有语言设置下，技能、状态、道具、剧情等文本中夹着尖括号和标记词语的问题，共修正 215 处。
    ○ 文本内容
        ■ 修复了「天之帷幕」与「深海入侵击退战」相关的技能、关卡与成就说明中，「圣像」错写为「圣象」的问题。
        ■ 修复了「提灯审查会」状态名称「灯芯之火」错写为「灯心之火」的问题。
        ■ 修复了部分文本中的「期冀」错写为「期颐」的问题。
        ■ 修复了意识潜游「扇下夜话」剧情中一处标点符号不正确的问题。
 
【战斗】
● 通用
    ○ 修复了算力消耗为 X 的指令卡打出后会错误地扣除银钥能量的问题。
● 唤醒体
    ○ 修复了在探索中查看唤醒体「卡拉布」的技能「粉雪魔咒」时，狂气数值错误地显示为代码的问题。
● 关卡
    ○ 修复了战斗中网络断开重新连接时，唤醒体或敌人的形象可能无法正常显示的问题。
    ○ 修复了部分关卡完成战斗后，会错误地重复播放一次调查开始动画的问题。
    ○ 修复了敌人「歌者」的敌人特性被错误地描述为「眷族」的问题。
    ○ 修复了敌人「亡雪者集群」与「噬灯者集群」的「集群效应」状态描述中，召唤的敌人名称错误的问题。
● 相位对弈
    ○ 修复了命轮「向上坠落」的「发现」效果可能会出现尚未开放的唤醒体「卡拉布」技能的问题。
 
【综合】
● 同调率
    ○ 修复了使用「黑池归还」后，唤醒体同调率错误地显示为 0 的问题。
    ○ 修复了部分唤醒体开启「曜闪」卡牌外观展示后，该唤醒体对应衍生卡也会错误地展示「曜闪」外观的问题，如「弥利亚姆」的「执妄」、「庞托斯」的「囚魇」等。
    ○ 修复了「相位对弈」编队、匹配成功等界面未能正常显示唤醒体「曜闪」效果的问题。
● 编队
    ○ 修复了某些情况下更换密契后编队保存异常的问题。
    ○ 修复了特殊编队中，上阵多套拥有相同「队伍唯一」效果的密契后，唯一效果失效提示的唤醒体错误的问题。
● 兼容性
    ○ 修复了使用 PC 游玩时，某些情况下无法使用快捷键出牌的问题。
    ○ 修复了使用 PC 游玩时，「唤醒体-同调率」界面的等级进度条下方出现错误线条的问题。
    ○ 修复了某些分辨率设置下，事件选项窗口的边框因位置偏移被部分遮挡的问题。
● 修复了「学籍档案」的「生涯成就」中会错误地展示尚未完成且尚未开放的成就的问题。
● 修复了「秘典书库」的「收集进度」中，有可领取奖励时红点提示未显示的问题。
● 修复了调查等级较高时，升级需求的调查经验数值未完整显示的问题。
● 修复了「邮件」的标题文本会错误地与界面装饰线重叠的问题。
● 修复了网络不稳定时，已解锁的「异梦视界」等篇章可能会错误地显示为未解锁的问题。
● 修复了在编队中选择密契或新增密契方案时，部位筛选页签 VI 错误地显示为 IV 的问题。

**V2.6.0.1 Online Maintenance Announcement**

Dear Keeper,
The Mythag Administration Office will conduct campus facility maintenance on  August 25, 2026 at 20:45(UTC+8) . You will be notified once the update is complete and you can re-enter the game. As an apology for any inconvenience caused by the update, we will provide a supply package. Wishing everyone a successful investigation!
In this update, items marked with ☆ at the end are based on feedback from Keepers in the community. Thank you all, Keepers, for your patience and support!
   
[Compensation]
Online Maintenance Compensation: Silver×50
   
[Claim Conditions]
The claiming time ends on September 8, 2026 at 23:59. Please remember to go to your mailox in time to claim the supply materials.
   
[Update Content]
1. Story
[Localization]
● English
    ○ Optimized the story descriptions for events in the "Before Spring Fades" activity to make the wording more natural.
    ○ Optimized the descriptions of certain profile pictures and Traphase Emotes rewarded from "Premium Topics" to align with the format of previous descriptions.
● Korean
    ○ Translation optimization for the Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon" skill descriptions.
    ○ Translation optimization for the gameplay description of the event "New Moon and Deep Snow".
 
2. Bug Fixes
[Story]
● Communicator
    ○ Fixed a typo in "Caraboo's" communication dialogue. 
● Localization
    ○ English
        ■ Fixed an issue where the Awakener's name was mistranslated in the description of the avatar "By the Silver Key: Caraboo".☆
        ■ Fixed an issue where the hint for unlocking the "Covenant Bond" mechanic was incorrectly displaying machine-translated text.☆
        ■ Fixed an issue where Koum's pronouns were incorrectly translated in the description of the "Deep-Buried" exploration event in Chapter 4 of Act 1 in the "Investigation" main story.☆
        ■ Fixed a typo in the Stage description of "Magic" in Chapter 7, Part 1, Stage 11 of the "Investigation" main story.☆
        ■ Fixed an issue where the enemy skill "Destiny's Elegy" description translation was inaccurate in Act 2, Chapter 5 of the main story "Fated Theater" in "Investigation".
        ■ Fixed a spelling error in Chapter 6 of Part 2 of the "Investigation" main story, "When the Mountain Feasts."☆
        ■ Fixed an issue where the Effect translation wording for the Relic "Foreign Stamp Album" was inaccurate.☆
        ■ Fixed an issue where the translation wording of "Death Resistance" was inconsistent in the Effect descriptions of the Wheel of Destiny "Poetic Bygone Days" and "35mm Magic".☆
        ■ Fixed an issue where some Event Gameplay mechanics in the event "Before Spring Fades" had inconsistent translation wording.☆
            ● Verse: Unified from "Offering" to "Verse."
            ● Synthesize Verse: Unified from "Synthesize Offering" to "Compose a Verse."
            ● Muse's Blessing: Unified from "Muzus Blessing/Muse's Blessing" to "The Muse's Favor".
            ● Spring's Offering: Unified from "Spring's Gift" to "The Gift of Spring."
    ○ Korean
        ■ Fixed an issue where "각성체" was incorrectly displayed as "깨어남체" and "실" was incorrectly displayed as "실타래".
        ■ Fixed an issue in the "Investigation" Story where a line of dialogue would display the raw text with angle bracket markers.
        ■ Fixed an issue where some text content was incorrect.

○ Multiple Languages
        ■ Fixed an issue in certain language settings (German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish, etc.) where the mission description in "Archives - Far North Archives" incorrectly displayed as Clear 6-8/6-4. The correct condition is Clear 6-9/6-5.
        ■ Fixed an issue where announcement content was incorrectly displayed in Traditional Chinese under certain language settings.
        ■ Fixed an issue where the set Effect description in the "Awakener-Covenant" interface might not display fully under certain language settings.
        ■ Fixed an issue in certain language settings where the Awakener/Wheel of Destiny description for some Character Event Awakenings in "Awaken" might not display completely.
        ■ Fixed an issue where, in certain language settings, performance markers in some text were not processed correctly, causing the raw angle bracket content to be displayed.
        ■ Fixed an issue in certain language settings where typographical markers used to handle singular/plural variations in skill and State descriptions were written incorrectly, causing the raw marker text to appear or the entire description to fail to display properly.
        ■ Fixed an issue where certain titles were not displaying correctly under some language settings.
        ■ Fixed an issue in all language settings where angle brackets and tagged words were mixed into text for skills, States, items, Stories, and more. A total of 215 instances were corrected.
    ○ Text content
        ■ Fixed an issue in the skill, Stage, and achievement descriptions related to "Veil of Heaven" and "Aequor Invasion Repulsion Battle" where "Sacred Icon" was incorrectly written as "Sacred Elephant."
        ■ Fixed an issue where the State name "Wick Flame" in "Lantern Committee" was incorrectly written as "Lampwick Flame".
        ■ Fixed an issue where "Hope" was incorrectly written as "Centenarian" in some text.
        ■ Fixed an issue in the Psyche Deepdive "Whispers Under the Fan's Shadow" Story where a punctuation mark was incorrect.
 
[Combat]
● General
    ○ Fixed an issue where Command Cards with a variable Arithmetica Cost of X would incorrectly deduct Keyflare after being played.
● Awakener
    ○ Fixed an issue where the Aliemus value was incorrectly displayed as code when viewing the Awakener "Caraboo"'s skill "Snowy Hex" during exploration.
● Stage
    ○ Fixed an issue where the appearance of Awakeners or enemies might not display correctly when reconnecting to the network during combat.
    ○ Fixed an issue where, after completing combat in certain stages, the investigation start animation would incorrectly play again.
    ○ Fixed an issue where the enemy trait of "The Singer" was incorrectly described as "Kynde."
    ○ Fixed an issue where the <Yellow:"Cluster Effect"> State description for the enemy clusters <Yellow:"Snowblight Cluster"> and <Yellow:"Lampbane Cluster"> displayed incorrect summoned enemy names.
● Traphase
    ○ Fixed an issue where the "Discover" Effect of the Wheel of Destiny "Falling Upward" could display skills of the Awakener "Caraboo" that had not yet been unlocked.

[General]
● Affinity
    ○ Fixed an issue where the Awakener's Affinity was incorrectly displayed as 0 after using "Genesis Return".
    ○ Fixed an issue where, after enabling the "Radiant Flash" card appearance for certain Awakeners, the Derived Cards associated with those Awakeners would incorrectly display the "Radiant Flash" appearance as well, such as "Miryam's" "Obsession" and "Pontos's" "Thrall-Gaunt".
    ○ Fixed an issue where the Awakener "Yaoshen" Effect was not displaying correctly in the Traphase Lineup, matchmaking success, and other screens.
● Lineup
    ○ Fixed an issue where the Lineup save would behave abnormally after switching Covenants in certain situations.
    ○ Fixed an issue in special Lineups where, after equipping multiple sets of Covenants with the same "Team Unique" Effect, the Awakener displayed in the Team Unique Effect deactivation Hint was incorrect.
● Compatibility
    ○ Fixed an issue where, in certain situations, cards could not be played using keyboard shortcuts when playing on PC.
    ○ Fixed an issue on PC where an incorrect line appeared below the Level progress bar in the "Awakener-Affinity" interface.
    ○ Fixed an issue where the border of the event options window was partially obscured due to positional offset at certain resolution settings.
● Fixed an issue in "Records" under "Career Achievements" where achievements that were incomplete and not yet available were incorrectly displayed.
● Fixed an issue where the red dot notification for claimable rewards was not displaying in the "Collection Progress" section of the "Library."
● Fixed an issue where the required EXP for Upgrade was not fully displayed when the survey Level was high.
● Fixed an issue where the title text of "Mail" would incorrectly overlap with the UI decorative line.
● Fixed an issue where unlocked chapters such as "Dreamscape" might incorrectly display as Locked when the network was unstable.
● Fixed an issue where the part filter tab VI was incorrectly displayed as IV when selecting a Covenant or adding a new Covenant scheme in the Lineup.
